full_prompt_en: A square, graphic painted illustration shows an older white-haired man crouching low among dense autumn foliage, with a long firearm angled diagonally down through the frame. The upper background is almost black, crowded with thin red and violet stems that climb behind his head. Broad leaves in peach, ochre, muted orange, and dusty pink overlap the branches around his shoulders and along both sides. The man sits slightly above the center, bent forward so his rounded back and heavy olive-brown coat occupy much of the middle. Short white hair and a white moustache surround a face partly shadowed by dark round glasses; his gaze points downward into the thicket. A wide tan strap crosses one shoulder and disappears behind the coat. His pale hands gather around the wooden stock and dark metal barrel of the firearm, which extends from the middle of the picture toward the lower right. An orange leaf crosses the barrel near the center, and a tangle of slender red twigs spans the lower foreground, partly veiling his trousers and the weapon. No open horizon or clear ground plane appears; foliage and figure fill the frame in close layers. Flat, angular color pieces model the face, coat folds, and leaves, while thin irregular lines give the stems a brittle, branching motion. Shadows are built mostly from deep olive, maroon, and purple color blocks rather than smooth gradients, making the warm leaves shine against the darker interior. Diffuse light from above and the left catches the hair, hands, and selected leaves, while the torso and background remain subdued. The overall composition is compact and tense, with the diagonal firearm cutting through a woven rhythm of warm leaf shapes and red linework.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、具有图形感的绘制插画呈现一位白发年长男子低低蹲在密集秋叶之间，一支长枪斜向下穿过画面。上方背景近乎黑色，细瘦的红紫枝条从头后密密向上攀升。桃色、赭黄、低饱和橙色和灰粉色的宽叶在肩周和两侧枝条间层层叠压。男子位于中央略偏上，俯身向前，弯起的背与厚重橄榄棕外套占据画面中间大片区域。短白发与白色八字胡围着一张被深色圆眼镜部分遮住的脸，视线朝下探入树丛。宽阔的棕褐色肩带跨过一侧肩膀，消失在外套后。浅色双手聚在长枪木制枪托与深色金属枪管附近，枪从中部延向右下角。一片橙叶在中央横过枪管，下方前景一团纤细红枝部分挡住裤子和枪。这里没有开阔地平线或清楚的地面，枝叶与人物以贴近的层次填满画幅。扁平的棱角状色片塑造面部、外套褶皱和叶片，纤细不规则线条让枝干显出脆而分叉的动势。阴影主要由深橄榄绿、栗红和紫色块构成，而非光滑渐层，使暖叶在暗处格外发亮。来自上方和左侧的漫射光照亮头发、双手和部分叶片，身体与背景仍较低沉。整体构图紧凑而带张力，斜向枪身切过暖叶形与红色线条编织的节奏。
style_prompt_en: The painted illustration uses interlocking angular color facets and fine, wiry contour lines to produce a dense but readable surface. Muted olive and charcoal masses carry the weight, while ochre, peach, crimson, and mauve accents appear as scattered bright planes and branching strokes. Layered shapes overlap tightly, flattening conventional depth into a tapestry of near and far fragments. Small pale highlights focus attention amid extensive dark color, and sharply directed diagonals interrupt the more tangled linear field. Edges alternate between clean graphic cuts and rough hand-drawn marks; smooth digital gradients give way to abrupt tonal steps and faint grain. Light is implied through relative color intensity and a few selected highlights rather than uniform illumination. The overall treatment is vivid, uneasy, and richly woven without losing the main silhouette.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘制插画以互相嵌合的棱角状色面和纤细如丝的轮廓线，形成密集但可读的表面。低饱和橄榄色和炭黑大块承担重量，赭色、桃色、深红与淡紫点缀成散落的亮面和分叉笔线。层叠形体紧紧交错，把传统纵深压平成近远碎片编织的图案。少量浅色亮部在大片深色中集中注意力，方向明确的斜线打断更纠缠的线性场。边缘在干净的图形切面与粗粝的手绘痕迹之间变化；突变的明暗阶梯和轻微颗粒取代光滑数字渐层。光主要由相对色彩强度和少数精选高光暗示，而非均匀照明。整体处理鲜明、略显不安、编织感丰厚，同时保留主要剪影的清晰度。
theme_en: An older white-haired man crouching among autumn leaves with a long firearm
theme_zh: 一位白发年长男子持长枪蹲在秋叶之间
name: Tomer Hanuka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
